Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_06 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND datetime(recorded_at) <= datetime('2026-10-24T12:00:00')), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), amounts AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.discount_until,i.terms_code,i.amount_minor,MAX(0,MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount_minor) FROM active a WHERE a.kind IN ('payment','credit') AND a.invoice_id=i.event_key AND a.currency=i.currency),0))-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.status='active' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.currency=i.currency),0)) AS unheld FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.status='active' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND i.due_date <= '2026-10-30'), valued AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.unheld,t.discount_bps,f.fx_num,f.fx_den,i.unheld*(CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= i.discount_until THEN 10000-t.discount_bps ELSE 10000 END)*f.fx_num AS numerator,10000*f.fx_den AS denominator FROM amounts i JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.status='active' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date <= i.business_date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active newer WHERE newer.currency=i.currency AND newer.business_date <= i.business_date AND newer.business_date > f.business_date)), rounded AS (SELECT event_key,unheld,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,CAST((2*numerator+denominator)/(2*denominator) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM valued) SELECT event_key,unheld,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,usd_cents,SUM(usd_cents) OVER () AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY event_key"}}
